verdicts.originalText: Hold-E opens a 9s bike-NS window (Flamestrider) — the Flamestrider 5-hit Pyro normals (gated on state: "nightsoulBlessing") fire during this window. The 9s baseline reflects the C0 NS pool drain rate (~9 pts/sec at 80 max points); C1 raises max NS to 120 (~13s effective), which is not modelled. Skill recast (E during Nightsoul Blessing to toggle Ring/Flamestrider mode) is not authored — schema has no apexDrive-like state to gate the recast frames. Pressing E again inside the Burst's NS window will fire the standard Tap form.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown as a 9s Hold window; C1's larger Nightsoul pool extends it to ~13s, which is not modeled. Recasting to toggle Ring/Flamestrider form is also not modeled — a second press fires the standard Tap form instead.
verdicts.rationale: Two real divergences survive: C1's larger Nightsoul pool extends the shown 9s Hold window (~13s, resource flow, not modeled) and the unauthored recast that toggles Ring/Flamestrider mode (a re-press falls back to Tap). The opening clause (Flamestrider normals fire during the window) describes working behavior since the Hold variant opens the state and gates those normals correctly; the drain-rate specifics and the apexDrive-state reasoning are curator-facing. Compress and de-name; not implementDelete because neither gap is wired.

Skill recast to toggle Ring/Flamestrider mode is unauthored — there is no apexDrive-like state to gate the recast frames, so a re-press falls back to the standard Tap variant.

verdicts.originalText:
Mavuika's Burst is gated on Fighting Spirit (≥50% of a 200-point pool, ≥60% at C1's 250 cap), not Energy. The schema requires a positive-integer energyCost; the value 100 is the in-game Fighting Spirit threshold (50% of 200), not Energy particles. Mavuika has no Energy bar in-game (gcsim EnergyMax=0). Particle generation from her skill (5 Pyro, 0.5s ICD) does not contribute to her own burst readiness — it feeds teammates' Energy.

The stance window represents Crucible of Death and Life (7s, frozen NS drain). The actual in-bike + NS time extends another ~1s past Crucible as the 10 NS points granted at burst hitmark drain off (~9 pts/sec); not modelled.
verdicts.proposedText: Runs on Fighting Spirit, not Energy — the Energy cost of 100 shown here is really the 50% threshold of a 200-point Fighting Spirit pool. The 7s window covers only Crucible of Death and Life; the actual bike/Nightsoul time runs ~1s longer, not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: Core divergence: the burst runs on Fighting Spirit, not Energy, so the shown 100 cost is the 50%-of-200 FS threshold, and the real bike/Nightsoul window is ~1s longer than the shown 7s Crucible. Fighting Spirit and the missing Energy bar are out-of-scope resource flow, and energyCost's positive-integer constraint forces the 100 placeholder, so this is a legitimate caveat, not implementDelete. The gcsim/schema mentions, the C1 250 cap, the skill's particle routing to teammates, and the residual-drain math all move to curator notes.

Already in curator notes: energyCost 100 = 50% of the 200 Fighting Spirit threshold, C1's 250 cap (~60% threshold), and the 7s = Crucible / ~8s-total residual drain (frozen Nightsoul drain during Crucible, then the 10 points granted at burst hitmark drain at ~9 pts/sec).
To preserve: Mavuika has no in-game Energy bar (gcsim EnergyMax=0), and her skill's particle generation (5 Pyro, 0.5s ICD) does not fuel her own burst readiness — it feeds teammates' Energy.

verdicts.originalText: The +40% allDmgBonus represents the max-Fighting-Spirit case (200 FS consumed at burst cast). Actual peak scales 0.2% per FS consumed, capped at 40% (200 FS). The decay-from-peak-to-0 over 20s is rendered as a fading bar. Per-FS-point peak scaling is not authored in v1 — schema needs decaying composed with perStack (the perStack primitive shipped 2026-05-08; composition with decaying is a v2 follow-up). C4 enhances this passive (removes the decay and adds +10% allDmgBonus); not modelled — C4 would need a constellation-conditional override of the decaying envelope, which the schema doesn't currently express.
verdicts.proposedText: The shown +40% DMG bonus assumes full Fighting Spirit (200 consumed); it actually scales 0.2% per point spent up to that cap, so lower amounts are not modeled. C4 removes the 20s decay and adds +10%, also not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: A legitimate optimistic assumption (shown +40% = max Fighting Spirit) plus two real gaps: per-FS-point scaling is unwired (needs decaying composed with the perStack primitive) and C4's decay removal and +10% are unauthored. The fading-bar rendering is working behavior; the schema-composition reasoning and version tags are curator-facing. Rewrite, not implementDelete, because the buff-value composition is not wired.
